```{r}
library(igraph)
library(visNetwork)

g <- make_graph("Franklin")
V(g)$title <- LETTERS[V(g)]

visNetwork::visIgraph(g) |>
  visInteraction(
    hover = TRUE,
    selectable = TRUE
  ) |>
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(
      enabled = TRUE
    )
  )
```
